article_title: Soft launches to late sittings: Six ways to get cheaper meals out

tasks.prompt: What is the main purpose of the article?
options: To argue that every restaurant should charge the same price
To give six practical ways of spending less on restaurant or takeaway food
To compare the nutritional value of six restaurant chains
To explain why supermarkets no longer offer loyalty points
tasks.correct_answer: To give six practical ways of spending less on restaurant or takeaway food
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה בנויה כרשימה של שש דרכים מעשיות לחסוך כסף בארוחות מחוץ לבית או באוכל לקחת.

tasks.prompt: How does the First Table app help diners save money?
options: It gives free meals after ten peak-time bookings
It converts supermarket points into airline miles
It offers 50% off food for a participating restaurant's first or last dining slot, for a small booking fee
It sells unknown surplus food at the end of the day
tasks.correct_answer: It offers 50% off food for a participating restaurant's first or last dining slot, for a small booking fee
tasks.explanation_hebrew: First Table מעניקה 50% הנחה על האוכל בהזמנת הישיבה הראשונה או האחרונה, תמורת עמלת הזמנה קטנה.

tasks.prompt: What can 50p in Tesco Clubcard points become at participating Prezzo restaurants?
options: £1.50 in vouchers
50% off the entire bill
A free children's meal
£5 in cash
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הדוגמה בכתבה, 50 פני בנקודות Clubcard ניתנים להמרה לשובר בשווי 1.50 ליש״ט אצל מסעדות Prezzo משתתפות.

tasks.prompt: Why do restaurants often offer their largest discounts at off-peak times?
options: Food is always cheaper to cook in the morning
Customers are legally required to eat earlier
Restaurants want every customer to order only one course
They want to fill seats that might otherwise remain empty
tasks.correct_answer: They want to fill seats that might otherwise remain empty
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הנחות בשעות שקטות הן תמריץ שמסייע למסעדות למלא מושבים מחוץ לשעות השיא.

options: A temporary opening period with discounts designed to attract customers and build awareness
A menu containing only drinks and desserts
A permanent closure on quiet weekdays
A loyalty scheme that requires an annual fee
tasks.correct_answer: A temporary opening period with discounts designed to attract customers and build awareness
tasks.explanation_hebrew: soft launch הוא שלב פתיחה שבו מסעדה חדשה מציעה הנחות כדי למשוך לקוחות ולעורר עניין לפני פעילות מלאה.

tasks.prompt: What does “hard to swallow” mean in the opening sentence?
options: Physically difficult to chew
Served at the wrong temperature
Difficult to accept because eating out is expensive
Available only as takeaway food
tasks.correct_answer: Difficult to accept because eating out is expensive
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי hard to swallow משמש כאן באופן מושאל: המחיר הגבוה קשה לקבל או להתמודד איתו.

tasks.prompt: Compare four different saving methods from the article and explain what a diner must do to use each one.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר ארבע שיטות שונות ולציין את התנאי או הפעולה הנדרשים בכל אחת.
expected_points: Join a restaurant loyalty programme to earn points, freebies or discounts
Book the first or last dining slot through First Table and pay a small booking fee
Redeem an EatClub offer for a walk-in visit
Use a children's meal deal with a paying adult
Find a new restaurant's soft-launch discount through opening newsletters
Convert supermarket loyalty points into restaurant vouchers
Use surplus-food apps to buy food that would otherwise be wasted

tasks.prompt: What trade-offs or limitations should diners consider when using the money-saving ideas?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לזהות לפחות שלוש מגבלות או פשרות מתוך פרטי הכתבה, ולא להציג את ההנחות כחסרות תנאים.
expected_points: Some loyalty schemes charge an annual fee
Off-peak discounts require eating earlier or later
First Table charges a booking fee
Kids' offers may require a paying adult or apply only during holidays
Soft-launch offers may be temporary
Supermarket vouchers work only with participating partners
Surplus-food app users may not know exactly what food they will receive
Offers vary by venue, city and time

tasks.prompt: Summarise the six approaches to cheaper meals and the economic context behind them.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שהוצאות המחיה ומחירי המסעדות גבוהים ולסכם את כל שש דרכי החיסכון בקצרה.
expected_points: More than a third of Britons are cutting back on restaurants
Restaurants face higher food, energy, wage and tax costs
Loyalty programmes offer points, freebies and discounts
Early or late sittings can cost less
Some venues offer free or low-cost children's meals
Soft launches let diners try new restaurants at a discount
Supermarket points can be converted into restaurant vouchers
Surplus-food apps sell or give away food that might otherwise be wasted

tasks.prompt: Create a realistic low-cost dining plan for a family or group using at least three ideas from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית תכנית מעשית, להסביר כיצד כל בחירה חוסכת כסף ולהכיר לפחות במגבלה אחת.
expected_points: Choose an off-peak breakfast, early dinner or late sitting
Check whether a children's meal deal requires a paying adult
Use an existing loyalty programme or restaurant reward
Look for a local soft launch
Convert eligible supermarket points into vouchers
Consider a surplus-food app for takeaway items
Mention booking fees, limited venues or uncertain surplus contents
Do not invent a discount amount not stated in the article
